caveat: Payment handles change; imposters are common. Always verify against the person's official website, verified social bio, or Linktree before sending money. This list aggregates openly published tip links and is not an endorsement.
apify_status: Apify MCP Actor runs blocked by monthly usage hard limit (platform-feature-disabled). Collection used Cursor WebSearch/WebFetch of public pages + merge of parallel open-web scrape under public-payment-links/.
sources_summary: Ko-fi and Buy Me a Coffee journalist/creator pages
limitations: Apify rag-web-browser / web-fetch / google-search-scraper blocked by usage limit
X/Twitter and Instagram often require login; bios largely inaccessible
Many tip pages use QR images without text handles (e.g. Luke Acker tip jar)
Directory listings (Carrd, Furipay, venue tip pages) are reputable aggregators but still require user verification
Handles change frequently; secondary-source rows flagged
